content:
Workshops across Ireland

Club information days, coaching workshops, Q&A, group coaching sessions and more

Talks and coaching sessions for cycling and triathlon clubs, led by Founder & Head Coach Matteo Cigala.

Organise a club talkWhat we offer ↓
CLUB INFORMATION DAYS

LEARN MORE

At Cigala Cycling we offer club information days, coaching workshops with presentations and Q&A, group coaching sessions.

Those events are led by Founder & Head Coach Matteo Cigala for cycling clubs. In the case of triathlon clubs, the events are led by both Matteo Cigala and Michael Black (Triathlon Coach at Cigala Cycling).

During these information days or coaching workshops, we provide valuable information for cyclists and triathletes. Information about training, periodisation, nutrition, common mistakes to avoid and much more.

What we offer

TALKS, Q&A AND GROUP SESSIONS

  • Club information days

    An introduction to training with structure for your members, with time for their questions.

  • Coaching workshops

    Presentations on training, periodisation and nutrition, followed by Q&A.

  • Group coaching sessions

    On the bike with your club: skills, pacing and a structured session together.

Topics

WHAT WE TALK ABOUT

  • Training and periodisation
  • Nutrition and fuelling
  • Common mistakes to avoid
  • Power, heart rate and testing
  • Racing and pacing
  • Recovery

Every talk is adapted to your club: road, gravel, track or triathlon, beginners or racers.

  • These sessions can be held all over Ireland.
  • For cycling and triathlon clubs
  • Drop us a line to organise and get a quote.
Organise a workshop

GET A QUOTE

We will be glad to hear from you to organise a workshop. Tell us about your club and what you would like to cover.
